3175.title: Plain-folder child environment selection fails
3175.rootCauseOneLine: Child environment defaulting lacks parent workspace facts and unconditionally selects a Git worktree; the path helper also excludes Unicode letters.
3175.proposedFix: Reuse the exact same-project non-git unmanaged parent environment, preserve managed worktrees for Git parents and mismatches, and allow Unicode letters and numbers in validated basenames.
3175.caveats: The reproduction is unit-level; no live BB instance was required. No issue-supplied code was executed.
